p: upon me: Thus belongs to all the prophets and ministers of God, but chiefly to Christ, of whose abundant graces everyone receives according as it pleases him to distribute.
brokenhearted: To them that are lively touched with the feeling of their sins.
captives: Who are in the bondage of sin.
acceptable year of the LORD: The time when it pleased God to show his good favour to man, which Paul calls the fulness of time, Ga 4:4.
vengeance of our God: For when God delivers his Church, he punishes his enemies.
ashes: Which was the sign of mourning.
trees of righteousness: Trees that bring forth good fruits, as in Mt 3:8.
generations: That is, for a long time.
stand and feed your flocks: They will be ready to serve you in all your needs.
Priests of the LORD: This is accomplished in the time of Christ, by whom all the faithful are made priests and kings, 1Pe 2:9, Re 1:6,5:10.
riches of the Gentiles: Read Isa 6:11:16.
double: Abundant recompence as this word is used, Isa 40:2.
they shall rejoice in: That is, the Jews.
their portion: That is, of the Gentiles.
double: While the Gentiles had dominion over the Jews in times past, now they will have double authority over them and possess twice as much.
robbery for burnt offering: I will not receive their offerings who are extortioners, deceivers, hypocrites or that deprive me of my glory.
their seed shall be known among: That is, of the Church.
I will greatly rejoice in the: He shows what will be the affection, when they feel their deliverance.
